name: write-visual-research-papers
description: Rigorous visual-first scientific manuscripts with explicit proof boundaries, HPC scaling, and rendered figure QA.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous papers with clear figures and evidence
interface.longDescription: A knowledge-only writing skill for concise, visually explained scientific papers. Covers claim dependencies, mathematical and computational evidence, conditional formalization, time and memory scaling, figure-by-figure QA, and reproducible LaTeX/Prism/PDF delivery.
defaultPrompt: Turn this research into a rigorous, visually explained paper.
Audit the proof claims, evidence boundaries, and figures.
Explain time and memory scaling with explicit assumptions.
